palettes.note: All physical OBJ slots are already occupied. A forest-local BG palette does not require recoloring shared OBJ banks. Preserve Drain bank and exact selected-context slots.

contracts.metatile: Stable id/type/coll/prop/framecount/speed; glitter unchanged unless root explicitly authorizes a surface classification change.
contracts.coll: Four8x8 quadrant bits within a16x16metatile; not cardinal-direction bits.
contracts.source_size: Each BG frame is exactly16x16, each index0..15, palette RGB555; composite groups author native full size then slice.
contracts.anchor: Actor coordinates are feet. Chest draw(logicaltx*16-8,ty*16-16); entry draw(tx*16-8,ty*16-48) outside or(tx*16,ty*16-48)inside. Chestfootprint remains one logical tile; cave exit remains pair.

warnings: reboot_core.tree is also used in title artwork; edit concept-local painter instead.
reboot_core.portal is also used in historical Drain terrain; override forest sheets locally.
reboot_core.lift_object defines exact ground/carried/thrown bush,rock,boulder,pot. Coordinate paired BG/OBJ repaint or retain both.
myst floor/glow cells on BG2 must be opaque floor, not transparent overlays, or16px black rectangles reappear.
interactive_props.py,forest_art.py,forest_sprites.py and ref/pack assets are inactive historical painters.
sprite mouth is Drain Cap return effect, not a cave/hollow/thicket portal.
Direct C references do not establish full reachability: arithmetic-base+offset groups and post-decoration replacements matter.
All463 retained environment IDs are coverage scope, including currently unselected source variants. No claim that all appear in a finite run.
